dict.string: FNDR needs screen recording access to index your screen content for search and provide Screen Guide assistance.
FNDR needs accessibility access to detect focused fields and type local auto-fill results into apps you use.
FNDR needs microphone access for voice search, Screen Guide, and meeting transcription.
FNDR uses speech recognition to hear what you ask the notch, including when you tell it to stop.
FNDR searches file names in Documents only when you ask Screen Guide, and may move an older FNDR speech runtime from Documents into private app storage once.
FNDR searches file names on Desktop only when you ask Screen Guide to find a file.
FNDR searches file names in Downloads only when you ask Screen Guide to find a file.
